name: Darwin Core published content
filter: coalesce(after()._type,before()._type) in ['dwcArticle','dwcTag','dwcAuthor','sanity.imageAsset'] && !(coalesce(after()._id,before()._id) in path('drafts.**')) && !(coalesce(after()._id,before()._id) in path('versions.**'))
projection: { 'projectId': '<real project id>', 'dataset': sanity::dataset(), 'documentId': coalesce(after()._id,before()._id), 'documentType': coalesce(after()._type,before()._type), 'revision': coalesce(after()._rev,before()._rev), 'operation': delta::operation() }
secret: <set through secure configuration; never commit a real secret>
